name: frappe-core-database
description: Use when performing database operations in ERPNext/Frappe v14-v16. Covers frappe.db methods, ORM patterns (frappe.get_doc, frappe.get_list), raw SQL, caching patterns, and performance optimization. Prevents common mistakes with database transactions and query building.
